fact: In Tunisia the AfriCultuReS project, implemented by OSS with CNCT, INRGREF, ONAGRI and the CRDAs, produced a 10 m Sentinel-2 land cover map of Tunisia, seasonal crop-type maps at governorate scale, an agricultural yield model and a geoportal for the national institutions (OSS guidance note, Tunis, August 2022).
title: L'Observation de la Terre au service de la sécurité alimentaire en Afrique
publisher: Observatoire du Sahara et du Sahel (OSS)
